summary: Pin is steep bush; nearest stop is a gardens car park about 80 m east.
reasons: Sealed car park backs onto bush

drivers.seclusion: No buildings mapped; car park sits against bush and parkland, no homes in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with painted bays opens off the access road; only its edge is visible.
drivers.traffic: Gardens access road beside it; visitor traffic by day.
drivers.convention: Gardens visitor car park; no vans or tents seen.

flags: Pin itself is steep bush: 14.5% mean grade, 26% max
Slope at the car park not measured
Waterway 24 m from pin; low ground near 47 m elevation
May be gated or patrolled at night
sun_shade: Pin under full canopy; car park edge partly shaded by trees on the west.

best_section.where: Sealed car park with bays at the east edge of the image, off the gardens road
